input.behavior_to_protect: After serializing and deserializing an ExceptionGroup whose children include both plain exceptions and nested groups, every child's type label must survive the round-trip intact.

description: Write one regression scenario showing that after serializing and deserializing an ExceptionGroup whose children include both plain exceptions and nested groups, every child's type label must survive the round-trip intact. The scenario must fail a mutant that stores only the message string.
requirements: Return one JSON test scenario using only the supplied values. It must make the correct behavior pass and the named mutant fail.
